violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: A certified food manager was not present at the beginning of the inspection
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ARRIVED DURING THE INSPECTION. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER MUST ALWAYS BE PRESENT AT ALL HOURS OF OPERATION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) for self-service, on ice: mild salsa (46f), medium salsa (48f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED THE SALSA TO BE WALK-IN COOLER TO COOLER TO 41f BEFORE PLACING OUT FOR SELF-SERVICE. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION. ENFORCEMENT MAY BE WARRANTED IF THIS CONTINUES.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. EHS observed staff changing tasks without washing hands.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC ABOUT WHEN TO WASH HANDS. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF MEMEBR TO WASH HANDS WHEN CHANGING TASKS. EHS EMAILED HANDWASHING FACT SHEET.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: Food Employees Wash Hands
violations.observation: Food employee failed to wash his or her hands prior to engaging in food preparation. EHS observed staff cooking and preparing individual servings of sauces without washing hands.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall be washing their hands as specified under 2-301.12. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL STAFF MUST WASH HANDS BEFORE TOUCHING FOOD. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO WASH HANDS BEFORE PUTTING GLOVES ON AND PREPARING RTE FOOD. EHS EMAIL GLOVE USE HAND OUT.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: EHS observed two squeeze bottles of sauces at the 2DR prep top with incorrect date marking. Upon discussion with PIC, the contents of one bottle was filled today. The contents of the other were filled on the date indicated on the label.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC DISCARDED THE EXPIRED SAUCE AND PROPERLY RELABELED THE NON-EXPIRED SAUCE.
